description: This file defines classes and components for the User Detail page in the Mattermost system console, including modals, user card, team management panel, and interactions for saving or canceling user edits.

classes.name: SaveChangesModal
classes.description: Represents the confirmation modal shown when saving changes to user details.

classes.name: UserDetail
classes.description: Main class for interacting with the User Detail page, including header, user card, team panel, and save/cancel actions.

classes.name: AdminUserCard
classes.description: Component representing the user's profile card with fields and actions.

classes.name: TeamMembershipPanel
classes.description: Component for managing team memberships associated with the user.

methods.name: getChanges
methods.description: Retrieves the list of change summaries shown in the save confirmation modal.

methods.name: toBeVisible
methods.description: Checks if the User Detail container and header are visible.

methods.name: goBack
methods.description: Navigates back from the User Detail page.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Clicks the save button to save user changes.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Clicks the cancel button to discard changes.

methods.name: waitForSaveComplete
methods.description: Waits until the save button is disabled, indicating save completion.
